scene_objective: Ben loses a sparring exchange he should not have lost, and the wrongness in the Force is the reason. Open on the night a problem he has been handling privately becomes a problem someone else could see.
opening_mode: Ben's guard drops a half-second late and his sparring partner's training blade catches him across the shoulder — the third time this week the wrongness in the Force has cost him a beat he should never miss

key_beats.beat_description: Ben's guard drops and his sparring partner scores a training-blade hit across his shoulder
Ben deactivates his training saber and waves off a rematch, claiming fatigue
Ben paces the empty salle alone, running through forms without igniting the blade — testing whether the wrongness disrupts muscle memory or Force timing
Luke appears in the doorway with a datapad and mission-ready posture

turning_point.trigger: Alone in the salle afterward, Ben runs a form through without igniting the blade and feels the wrongness steal a beat he cannot spare. He stops pretending it is fatigue.
turning_point.shift: Alone in the salle afterward, Ben runs a form through without igniting the blade and feels the wrongness steal a beat he cannot spare. He stops pretending it is fatigue.

closing_beat: Luke appears in the doorway with a datapad and an expression Ben knows means a mission

emotional_arc.shift: Restless unease -> frustrated isolation -> reluctant hope
